submit_request.description: Add a model request to the queue. The response contains the request ID and the URLs for status, result, and cancellation. The queue keeps the request until a runner is available. The queue has no size limit unless you send fal_max_queue_length.

error.description: The error message. Present only when the request failed.

logs.description: The runner logs. The value is `null` unless you send `logs=1`.

metrics.description: Present when the status is `COMPLETED`. Empty in other states.

inference_time.description: The run time on the runner, in seconds.

queue_position.description: The number of requests in front of this request. Present only when the status is `IN_QUEUE`.

status.description: `COMPLETED` is the final state. A failed or cancelled request also has the status `COMPLETED`.
